description: Standings of one public ladder, by id or ladder link: each named player's Lichess and chess.com rating, change and games in one time control, sorted as on the ladder page, plus this week's awards and recent results. Comes in pages; use offset for the next page. Private and link-only ladders are never returned.

id.description: The ladder id, the part after /l/ in its link (for example demo-club), or the whole link.

offset.description: Players to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

period.description: Days to measure change over: 7 (default) or 30, or season for a ladder with seasons.

results_limit.description: How many recent weekly awards and challenge results to include. Default 5.

time_control.description: Time control to rank by. Default: the one most of the club plays.

name: get_public_ladder
title: Get a public ladder
